g.text: Three different markets. One identical dataset.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans'; fill: #1f2933

g.text: The bars differ in every panel; the two recorded timestamps do not. Read the strip along the bottom of each panel:

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans'; fill: #1f2933

g.text: what reaches disk is the same in all three, so no statistic computed from it can tell these worlds apart.
